name: Balsag's Sunwheel: Gunstock
desc: Blueprint for a firearm accessory that can be used to create said inscribed weapon accessory by consuming materials in the Eye of Graeae's HUD.

value.text:
Firearms are more stable when firing. When you perform a slide, you also automatically reload your gun. Additionally, the equipping character gains a 20%
Pyro,
Hydro, and
Cryo DMG Bonus.
Unlocked from Edge of Survival challenges
